# regru Provider

The provider reads existing DNS zones and manages their records and SOA settings through the [reg.ru](https://reg.ru) [Reseller API v2](https://www.reg.ru/reseller/api2doc).

Set username and password in the provider configuration or use `REGRU_USERNAME` and `REGRU_PASSWORD`. Configured values take precedence over environment variables.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    regru = {
      source = "denisinvader/regru"
    }
  }
}

provider "regru" {
  # Can be set with the REGRU_USERNAME environment variable.
  username = var.regru_username
  # Can be set with the REGRU_PASSWORD environment variable.
  password = var.regru_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the reg.ru API. Can also be set with the `REGRU_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `username` (String) Email address used as the username for the reg.ru API. Can also be set with the `REGRU_USERNAME` environment variable.
